purpose: Original SWG XR application and shortcut icon
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: square desktop shortcut application icon for the original fan project "SWG XR", a VR-first Star Wars Galaxies client. Restrained cyan holographic light and warm gold metallic edging on a very dark navy inset, matching an in-world sci-fi datapad. Strong simple silhouette, generous clean shapes and thick lettering that remain readable at small desktop icon sizes; subtle dimensional bevels, no tiny decoration, no realistic scene. Center one compact emblem filling about 85 percent of a square canvas. Transparent background outside the emblem, crisp alpha edges, no cast shadow outside, no watermark, no other words. Original design, not the official Star Wars logo.
format_note: PNG preserves generated alpha; ICO contains standard desktop sizes derived by format conversion.
